title: ArchaeoPhD Step 4 Development & Tuning Set
description: Development set containing 22 forensic audit facts, 5 targeted challenge cases, 11 synthetic rule coverage cases, and 10 real-page clean positive controls from the 16 development pages (Total N = 48). Freely used for generator development and tuning.
